scientific_audit_and_limitations.internal_holdout_boundary: Scaffold-holdout cross-validation evaluates generalization to unseen chemical scaffolds from within the same assay distribution. It does NOT establish external dataset validation, inter-laboratory reproducibility, or real-world clinical safety.
scientific_audit_and_limitations.discrimination_vs_calibration: While ROC-AUC and PR-AUC demonstrate consistent degradation under scaffold-holdout partitions (generalization penalty), probability quality metrics (Brier score and log loss) are strongly influenced by endpoint base rate and uncalibrated tree confidence skew.
scientific_audit_and_limitations.applicability_domain_findings: Out-of-fold performance drops systematically as test molecules exhibit lower maximum Tanimoto similarity to the training fold. Molecules with Tanimoto similarity < 0.40 exhibit pronounced performance degradation, reinforcing the necessity of MoleculeIQ's applicability-domain warnings.
scientific_audit_and_limitations.rare_positive_endpoint_caveat: Endpoints with severe class imbalance (e.g. SR-HSE prevalence ~5.2%, SR-p53 prevalence ~6.2%) contain few positive scaffold clusters. Scaffold-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals on these endpoints have higher variance and reflect within-cluster positive correlation.
